deepSwePricing.policy: Match DeepSWE displayed pricing, including its promotional and peak-rate choices.

benchmarks.label: Intelligence Index
benchmarks.description: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3.2, a weighted composite of 10 independently run evaluations.
benchmarks.costNote: Weighted average cost per Intelligence Index task.

benchmarks.label: AA Coding Agent Index v1.5
benchmarks.description: An equally weighted composite of DeepSWE v1.1, SWE-Atlas-QnA, Terminal-Bench v4. Each component averages pass@1 across three attempts per task.
benchmarks.costNote: Average observed pay-per-token API cost per task, including cached-input discounts and cache-write pricing where Artificial Analysis has that telemetry.

benchmarks.label: AA-Briefcase v1.1
benchmarks.description: Agentic knowledge work across 91 tasks in four multi-week business projects. The headline Elo combines rubric checks, analytical quality, and presentation.
benchmarks.costNote: Average cost per AA-Briefcase task.

benchmarks.label: GDPval-AA v2.1
benchmarks.description: Measures agentic performance on 220 economically valuable tasks across 44 occupations and nine industries. Models browse, use a shell, and produce realistic deliverables such as spreadsheets, presentations, documents, and diagrams.
benchmarks.costNote: Average cost per GDPval-AA task.

benchmarks.label: AutomationBench-AA
benchmarks.description: Workflow automation across 657 tasks in simulated business applications. Scores measure the share of objectives completed, with zero credit when a guardrail is violated.
benchmarks.costNote: Average cost per AutomationBench-AA task.

benchmarks.label: Terminal-Bench 4.0 — AA models
benchmarks.description: A harder set of 66 terminal tasks across software, science, operations, and security. Artificial Analysis reports pass@1 averaged over three attempts per task.
benchmarks.costNote: Average cost per Terminal-Bench 4.0 task.

benchmarks.label: Terminal-Bench 4.0 — official
benchmarks.description: Official submissions on the 66-task Terminal-Bench 4.0 benchmark. Each row identifies the submitted agent, model, and reasoning settings. These runs are independent of AA’s evaluations.
benchmarks.pricingNote: Source-reported total spend divided by the number of scored trials. Historical submissions are not independently repriced to current API rates.
benchmarks.costNote: Official total_cost_usd ÷ n_trials; average cost per scored task attempt.

benchmarks.label: SciCode
benchmarks.description: A scientist-curated coding evaluation with 288 subproblems drawn from 80 laboratory problems across 16 scientific disciplines. It requires both domain reasoning and correct implementation of research-oriented numerical code.
benchmarks.costNote: Average cost per SciCode task.

benchmarks.label: Humanity’s Last Exam
benchmarks.description: Expert-vetted academic questions across mathematics, science, engineering, humanities, and social science, using AA’s evaluated subset.
benchmarks.costNote: Average cost per Humanity’s Last Exam task.

benchmarks.label: GDP.pdf
benchmarks.description: Professional reasoning over long PDF documents across 100 tasks and ten domains. The All-pass score counts attempts that satisfy every grading criterion.
benchmarks.costNote: Average cost per GDP.pdf task.

benchmarks.label: CritPt
benchmarks.description: Tests research-scale physics reasoning with composite challenges. Answers include symbolic expressions, numerical arrays, and executable functions.
benchmarks.costNote: Average cost per CritPt task.

benchmarks.label: AA-Omniscience
benchmarks.description: Measures factual reliability across 6,000 questions, 42 topics, and six economically relevant domains. The index rewards correct answers, penalizes confident hallucinations, and does not penalize abstention.
benchmarks.costNote: Average cost per AA-Omniscience task.

benchmarks.label: AA-LCR v1.1
benchmarks.description: Evaluates whether models can retrieve, connect, and synthesize evidence from documents ranging from roughly 10,000 to 100,000 tokens. It targets reasoning over distant context, not simple needle retrieval.
benchmarks.costNote: Average cost per AA-LCR task.

benchmarks.label: τ³-Banking
benchmarks.description: Tests customer-support agents on realistic banking workflows. Success requires searching a large policy knowledge base, maintaining conversational state, and executing the correct sequence of tool calls without violating constraints.
benchmarks.costNote: Average cost per τ³-Banking task.

benchmarks.label: Terminal-Bench v2.1 — AA models
benchmarks.description: Evaluates agents on 89 verified terminal tasks across software engineering, system administration, security, data processing, and model training. Each task runs in a real sandbox and is checked by an executable verification suite.
benchmarks.costNote: Average cost per Terminal-Bench v2.1 task.

benchmarks.label: Terminal-Bench 2.1 — official
benchmarks.description: Official submissions on the 89-task Terminal-Bench 2.1 benchmark. Each row identifies the submitted agent, model, and reasoning settings. These runs are independent of AA’s evaluations.
benchmarks.pricingNote: Source-reported total spend divided by the number of scored trials. Historical submissions are not independently repriced to current API rates.
benchmarks.costNote: Official total_cost_usd ÷ n_trials; average cost per scored task attempt.

benchmarks.label: GPQA Diamond
benchmarks.description: The hardest 198 questions from GPQA, written and validated by domain experts in physics, biology, and chemistry. The questions are deliberately Google-resistant and require graduate-level scientific reasoning.
benchmarks.costNote: Average cost per GPQA Diamond task.

benchmarks.label: Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 — AA
benchmarks.description: Scientific research workflows across 70 terminal tasks in five scientific domains. AA uses mini-swe-agent and reports pass@1 averaged over three attempts per task, with isolated verification.
benchmarks.costNote: Average API cost per Terminal-Bench-Science task using AA’s canonical token counts and rates.

benchmarks.label: Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 — official
benchmarks.description: Official submissions on the 70-task Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 benchmark. Each row identifies the submitted agent, model, and reasoning settings. These runs are independent of AA’s evaluations.
benchmarks.pricingNote: Source-reported total spend divided by the number of scored trials. Historical submissions are not independently repriced to current API rates.
benchmarks.costNote: Official total_cost_usd ÷ n_trials; average cost per scored task attempt.

benchmarks.label: AA-AnalystAgent
benchmarks.description: End-to-end quantitative analysis across 80 questions in 14 business and scientific domains. Models use AA’s Stirrup harness to work from source spreadsheets and documents in a Python sandbox.
benchmarks.costNote: Average API cost per AA-AnalystAgent question using AA’s token counts and rates.

benchmarks.label: Harvey LAB-AA v1.1
benchmarks.description: Legal deliverables across 120 private tasks and 24 practice areas. The headline Hallucination-Gated All-Pass Rate requires every rubric criterion to pass and no material hallucination; scores are separate from v1.0.
benchmarks.costNote: Average API cost per Harvey LAB-AA task using AA’s token counts and rates.

benchmarks.label: EnterpriseOps-Gym-AA
benchmarks.description: Stateful enterprise workflows across 1,117 tasks in eight domains. AA’s Stirrup agents operate sandboxed enterprise systems through MCP tools and are graded on the resulting database state.
benchmarks.costNote: Average API cost per EnterpriseOps-Gym-AA task using AA’s token counts and rates.

benchmarks.label: ITBench-AA
benchmarks.description: Kubernetes incident root-cause analysis on 59 public and private tasks, with three repeats through Stirrup. Precision at full recall gives zero when a ground-truth root cause is missed.
benchmarks.costNote: Average API cost per ITBench-AA incident using AA’s token counts and rates.

benchmarks.label: MLCR-AA
benchmarks.description: Medical long-context reasoning across 60 questions over fragmented patient records. The overall pass rate requires a concise answer judged both complete and accurate.
benchmarks.costNote: Average API cost per MLCR-AA question using AA’s token counts and rates.

benchmarks.label: MMMU-Pro
benchmarks.description: Multimodal reasoning across 1,730 ten-option multiple-choice questions in 30 academic disciplines. AA reports pass@1 with answer extraction.
benchmarks.costNote: Average API cost per MMMU-Pro question using AA’s canonical token counts and rates.

benchmarks.label: FrontierCode 1.1 Main — AA
benchmarks.description: AA’s independent Stirrup runs on FrontierCode 1.1 Main’s 100 tasks, averaged over three attempts. Quality-adjusted mergeability is graded with held-out tests and rubrics; these are separate runs from Cognition’s leaderboard.
benchmarks.costNote: Average API cost per FrontierCode Main task using AA’s token counts and rates.

benchmarks.label: FrontierCode 1.1 Main — Cognition
benchmarks.pricingNote: Source-reported costs; a complete token and rate breakdown is unavailable for independent repricing.
benchmarks.description: Cognition’s quality-focused coding benchmark asks whether an open-source maintainer would merge the generated change. Main contains 100 difficult tasks and scores correctness, tests, scope discipline, style, and codebase standards across five rollouts per effort.
benchmarks.costNote: Average model/API cost per FrontierCode Main task; the plotted score is the quality-adjusted mergeability score.

benchmarks.label: DeepSWE v1.1 — Datacurve
benchmarks.pricingNote: Costs use DeepSWE’s updated API rates, including its promotional and peak-rate choices.
benchmarks.description: A contamination-resistant, long-horizon software-engineering benchmark with 113 original tasks across 91 repositories and five languages. Hand-written behavioral verifiers score complete mini-swe-agent rollouts rather than patches copied from historical pull requests.
benchmarks.costNote: Mean rollout cost using DeepSWE’s displayed pricing adjustments, including promotional and peak-rate choices. Pass@1 is unchanged.

benchmarks.label: LiveBench 2026-06-25
benchmarks.pricingNote: Source-reported run costs; not uniformly repriced to current API rates.
benchmarks.description: A contamination-conscious benchmark of 23 objective tasks across reasoning, coding, agentic coding, mathematics, data analysis, language, and instruction following. Questions refresh every six months and are graded against verifiable answers.
benchmarks.costNote: Published cost per successful task, which combines per-question spend with the model’s success rate rather than showing raw API price.

benchmarks.label: LiveBench 2.0 (2026-10-14)
benchmarks.pricingNote: Source-reported run costs; not uniformly repriced to current API rates.
benchmarks.description: Long-horizon work across seven suites: long-horizon tasks, reasoning, coding, browser use, data analysis, research, and design. Overall is the mean of suites with a score, with one run per suite. This task set is separate from LiveBench v1.
benchmarks.costNote: Published cost per successful task: pooled suite spend divided by task count and the rounded Overall success rate.
